item.text: {"report":"The implementation is a compact shared-query state machine. The problematic path is present: an offline initial `online` attempt is paused, and removing its final observer only cancels retries, leaving it eligible for reconnect. I’m narrowing the cancellation to that never-entered, uncached initial attempt so cached refreshes and entered unconsumed work keep their existing behavior."}

item.command: /usr/bin/bash -lc "/runtime/node --input-type=module -e \"import { Session } from './src/session.js'; const tick=()=>Promise.resolve(); let calls=0; const s=new Session({queryFn:c=>{calls++; return c.signal.aborted?'aborted':'ok'},timers:{schedule(){}}},{online:false}); const h=s.subscribe('fresh'); if(s.snapshot('fresh').fetchStatus"'!=='"'paused')throw Error('fresh should pause'); s.unsubscribe(h); s.online(true); await tick(); if(calls"'!==0)throw Error('"'retired fresh attempt invoked'); if(s.snapshot('fresh').fetchStatus"'!=='"'idle')throw Error('cancel did not restore idle'); let cachedCalls=0; const c=new Session({queryFn:()=>++cachedCalls,timers:{schedule(){}}}); c.subscribe('cached'); await tick(); const h2=c.subscribe('cached'); c.online(false); c.unsubscribe(h2); c.online(true); await tick(); if(cachedCalls"'!==2)throw Error('"'cached paused refresh did not resume'); let observed; let settle; const p=new Promise(r=>settle=r); const a=new Session({queryFn:ctx=>{observed=ctx.signal; return p},timers:{schedule(){}}}); const ha=a.subscribe('abort'); a.unsubscribe(ha); if("'!observed.aborted)throw Error('"'consumed request was not aborted'); settle('late'); await tick(); if(a.snapshot('abort').status"'!=='"'pending'||a.snapshot('abort').fetchStatus"'!=='"'idle')throw Error('late result overwrote cancelled attempt'); console.log('lifecycle checks passed')\""

item.text: {"report":"Fixed `src/session.js`: offline-paused, never-entered initial `online` attempts are now cancelled when their last observer leaves, so reconnect cannot later invoke their query function with a live signal. Cached refreshes and already-entered unconsumed requests retain background behavior. Verified with local `/runtime/node` lifecycle checks for target cancellation, cached paused refresh resume, consumed-request abort, and late-result isolation. No full test suite is present."}
